title: Planet Tweaks V3.4.1 - Zero Delay Kernel & Input Stability Release
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.4.1: (1) Purged Reboot Driver Deadlocks: Completely removed 'Keyboard Packet Queue Depth (5 Buffer)' and '0 Delay Before Acceptance' from all automated zero-delay packs (Peterbot, Pure Zero Delay, Low Latency Input) to eliminate multi-keyboard boot deadlocks and FilterKeys lockout on restart. (2) Demoted Dangerous Buffers: Moved all low-queue depth keyboard tweaks to Opt-In manual configuration with safety warnings. (3) Live Input & Kernel Performance: Maintained stock 100 Keyboard Queue Depth while retaining 100% of zero-latency kernel timers, Win32 priority separation, and raw input optimizations. (4) System Restore Storage Expansion: Shadow copy storage expanded to 100 GB with fail-safe driver baseline rollbacks. (5) Full Verification: 100% clean builds across Public and Private editions with 0 compiler errors.
